Declared offset tetrahedral neighbor rule; no space-filling requirement
provides: Exact centers in both directions and an involutive lattice exchange
Fourfold reciprocal-center graph and genuine six-link cycles
Conditional closed-saturation P=N obstruction; unequal counts require boundary or occupation data
